column3: MT 39:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew; “I will keep a muzzle for my mouth” is rendered “I will guard my mouth as with a muzzle.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I was silent from good” is rendered “I refrained even from good,” and “was stirred up” as “grew worse.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB sets verses 4–13 as a quotation.
Close to the Hebrew; “fleeting” is rendered “transient.”
“All humankind standing is only vanity” is rendered “every man at his best is a mere breath.”
“Only in an image” is rendered “as a phantom,” and “only vanity” as “for nothing”; NASB supplies “riches.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I have come to an end” is rendered “I am perishing.”
Close to the Hebrew; “what is desired” is rendered “what is precious,” and “vanity” as “a mere breath.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a sojourner … a resident alien” is rendered “a stranger … A sojourner,” and “ancestors” as “fathers.”
Close to the Hebrew; “look away from me” is rendered “Turn Your gaze away from me,” and “be cheerful” as “smile again.”
